nusmp.page.book_mercury.quicksilver_pool: Quicksilver Pool - a puddle of liquid mercury spreads where you aim (up to 24 blocks). For 3 seconds it pulses once a second in a 3.5 block radius, hurting foes and slowing them heavily; damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_needles: Silver Needles - four needle-fine slivers of mercury fan out from the grimoire; each hit poisons the target for 3 seconds (the attribute page notes mercury is toxic). Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_whip: Mercury Whip - a lash of liquid silver cracks 9 blocks along your line of sight, hitting everything on it and pushing it back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_skate: Silver Skate - you glide up to 9 blocks forward on a film of mercury without hurting anyone; a pure move to close a gap or get out of one.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_dome: Silver Dome - a flowing dome of mercury closes round you for 6 seconds: Resistance II and two absorption hearts. The dome is the one the Silver Guardian's armour is poured from.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_shackles: Silver Shackles - mercury wraps one target within 18 blocks and sets hard, holding it in place and weakening it. The shared control lock applies; bosses resist it.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_wave: Silver Wave - a breaking wave of mercury rolls 8 blocks in front of you and shoves everything in the cone back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.toxic_quicksilve: Toxic Quicksilver - one dense drop of mercury flies at the target and lodges in the wound: strong poison for 5 seconds and Weakness. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.liquid_metal_tid: Liquid Metal Tide - a wide tide of mercury surges 14 blocks forward, hitting up to 8 foes, throwing them back and slowing them for 3 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.mercury_vortex: Mercury Vortex - a whirlpool of silver opens where you aim (up to 18 blocks) and drags every foe within 5 blocks toward its centre, hurting and slowing them.
nusmp.page.book_mercury.silver_wing_barr: Silver Wing Barrage - five homing spears of mercury, thrown like the beat of the Silver Eagle's wings, seek the nearest foes and poison what they strike. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_bullets: Sand Bullets - three packed pellets of sand fly in a short fan. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.dust_veil: Dust Veil - a ring of fine dust bursts round you, blinding every foe within 4 blocks for 3 seconds and hurting them a little. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.dune_step: Dune Step - you slide up to 9 blocks forward on a wave of sand without hurting anyone, a quick reposition.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_whip: Sand Whip - a lash of packed sand cracks 9 blocks forward, hitting everything on the line and pushing it back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_wall: Sand Wall - sand rises and sets into a wall of sandstone in front of you (4 wide, 3 high) that crumbles away after 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_mirage: Sand Mirage - a shimmering double of sand draws the gaze of hunting mobs within 16 blocks, which lose your trail, and you turn invisible for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_sand.scouring_sand: Scouring Sand - a cutting gale of grit sweeps 7 blocks in front of you, blinding and slowing everything in the cone. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sinking_dune: Sinking Dune - the ground where you aim turns to loose sand for 4 seconds: foes in a 5 block radius are dragged down (heavy Slowness, Mining Fatigue) and hurt every half second.
nusmp.page.book_sand.sand_cyclone: Sand Cyclone - a cyclone of sand spins up where you aim (up to 18 blocks) and pulls every foe within 5 blocks toward its eye, blinding and hurting them.
nusmp.page.book_sand.dune_collapse: Dune Collapse - a whole dune caves in on the spot you aim at: a 7 block blast throws foes aside, blinds them for 3 seconds and slows them for 4. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_needle: Steel Needle - a hair-thin needle of steel is fired along your line of sight (16 blocks) and pierces everything on it. Damage scales with EP. (Name seen in a game guide, not the manga.)
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_strike: Steel Strike - a steel-clad blow lands in a short cone in front of you and knocks foes back. Damage scales with EP. (Name seen in a game guide, not the manga.)
nusmp.page.book_steel.lance_vault: Lance Vault - you plant a steel lance and vault up to 8 blocks forward; where you land, foes within 3.5 blocks are hurt and shoved back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_chariot: Steel Chariot - a chariot of steel carries you up to 12 blocks forward, running down everything on the way and shoving it aside. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_coffin: Steel Coffin - plates of steel close round one target within 16 blocks, holding it still and weakening it. The shared control lock applies.
nusmp.page.book_steel.restraining_steel: Restraining Steel - steel bars rise from the ground where you aim for 3 seconds; foes in a 4 block radius are hurt once a second and almost rooted.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_plating: Steel Plating - plates of steel fold over you for 10 seconds: Resistance II and two absorption hearts.
nusmp.page.book_steel.lance_downpour: Lance Downpour - a rain of steel lances falls on the spot you aim at for 3 seconds, hitting foes in a 5 block radius every 0.6 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.steel_blade_storm: Steel Blade Storm - a wide fan of spinning steel blades sweeps 9 blocks in front of you, cutting every foe in the cone and pushing it back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_steel.thousand_lances: Thousand Lances - the grimoire sheds lance after lance of steel; five homing lances seek the nearest foes and drive them back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.gravel_spray: Gravel Spray - a handful of gravel is flung in a cone 5 blocks long, stinging and slowing everything it hits. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.flint_shards: Flint Shards - four sharp flakes of flint fly in a fan. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.rockslide_skate: Rockslide Skate - you ride a sliding sheet of rock up to 8 blocks forward without hurting anyone.
nusmp.page.book_rock.rock_fortress: Rock Fortress - a wall of rock studded with spikes rises in front of you (4 wide, 3 high) for 8 seconds; anyone who strikes you meanwhile is cut by thorns.
nusmp.page.book_rock.rolling_boulder: Rolling Boulder - a boulder rolls 12 blocks along your line of sight, hitting everything in its 2 block width and throwing it aside. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.rock_hide: Rock Hide - your skin hardens to rock for 10 seconds: Resistance, stronger melee hits and thorns for whoever strikes you.
nusmp.page.book_rock.avalanche_crush: Avalanche Crush - an avalanche of rock pours over the spot you aim at for 3 seconds: foes in a 6 block radius are hit every half second, pushed and slowed. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_rock.mountain_fall: Mountain Fall - a whole crag drops where you aim: an 8 block blast hurls foes away and leaves them slowed for 4 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ochre_dust: Ochre Dust - a cloud of red pigment bursts round you; foes within 4 blocks are hurt a little and weakened for 4 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.pigment_darts: Pigment Darts - three darts dipped in red ochre fly in a fan and mark whoever they hit (Glowing for 5 seconds). Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.red_handprint: Red Handprint - a hand of wet ochre is slapped on one target: it glows for 6 seconds and is weakened for 4. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ancestral_danc: Ancestral Dance - a painted dance calls the ancestors: you and your allies within 8 blocks recover 15 percent of their health (healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ochre_spear: Ochre Spear - a spear of hardened red clay is thrown and bursts on impact in a 2.5 block radius, pushing foes back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ochre_wall: Ochre Wall - baked red clay rises in front of you as a wall (4 wide, 3 high) that crumbles after 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.ochre_mire: Ochre Mire - the ground where you aim turns to red mud for 4 seconds: foes in a 5 block radius are bogged down and weakened, and hurt every half second.
nusmp.page.book_red_ochre.red_earth_rite: Red Earth Rite - the full ritual: red earth erupts round you in a 7 block circle, weakening foes for 6 seconds, slowing them and pushing them back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.pebble_shot: Pebble Shot - three stones are flicked from the grimoire in a short fan. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.stone_fist: Stone Fist - your fist is wrapped in stone and the blow lands in a short cone, knocking foes back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.stone_skin: Stone Skin - your skin turns to stone for 8 seconds: Resistance and a stronger melee hit.
nusmp.page.book_stone.granite_lance: Granite Lance - a row of granite spikes tears up the ground for 14 blocks and tosses what it hits into the air. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.pillar_burst: Pillar Burst - pillars of stone burst up at the spot you aim at, lifting every foe within 4 blocks. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.boulder_drop: Boulder Drop - a shadow marks the ground where you aim; a second later a boulder lands there and hurts every foe within 3.5 blocks. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_stone.quarry_collapse: Quarry Collapse - the ground where you aim caves in with falling stone for 4 seconds: foes in a 6 block radius are hit every half second and slowed.
nusmp.page.book_stone.colossus_stampede: Colossus Stampede - a colossus of stone charges 22 blocks forward, trampling everything in a 3 block lane and flinging it up and aside. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.ore_shard_shot: Ore Shard Shot - one sharp shard of ore is fired at the target. Damage scales with EP. (Inspired by the Mineral Fragment skill of a mobile game, not the manga.)
nusmp.page.book_mineral.mineral_assault: Mineral Assault - ore thrusts up out of the ground along 8 blocks of your line of sight and tosses foes on it. Damage scales with EP. (Name seen in a mobile game, not the manga.)
nusmp.page.book_mineral.ore_sight: Ore Sight - the grimoire hums at the veins of living things: every foe within 5 blocks is hurt a little and shown Glowing for 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.talos_doll: Talos Doll - a doll of ore in your image stands where you were: mobs within 16 blocks lose your trail and you turn invisible for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.heavy_armored_ti: Heavy Armored Titan - heavy ore armour grows over you for 12 seconds: Resistance II, two absorption hearts, stronger melee hits and thorns for whoever strikes you.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.geode_burst: Geode Burst - a geode is thrown and cracks open on impact, spraying shards over 3.5 blocks and pushing foes back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.talos_doll_army: Talos Doll Army - a troop of ore dolls rises round you for 4 seconds and strikes every foe within 5 blocks twice a second while it holds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_mineral.colossal_ore_fis: Colossal Ore Fist - a fist of solid ore as big as a house drives 16 blocks forward, smashing through a 3 block lane and hurling foes away. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.grit_slash: Grit Slash - a blade of sandstone grit cuts a cone 4.5 blocks long, blinding what it touches for 2 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.sandstone_hurl: Sandstone Hurl - a lump of sandstone is thrown and bursts on impact in a 2 block radius. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.sandstone_leap: Sandstone Leap - a sandstone block flings you up to 7 blocks forward; where you land, foes within 3 blocks are hurt and slowed. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.rock_fall: Rock Fall - rocks come down where you aim after a short warning (1.2 seconds), hurting every foe within 4 blocks and pushing them back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.sandstone_shel: Sandstone Shell - sandstone hardens over you for 10 seconds: Resistance, stronger melee hits and thorns for whoever strikes you.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.quarry_sweep: Quarry Sweep - a slab of sandstone is swept along 12 blocks of ground, hitting everything in its 2 block width and pushing it aside. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_sandstone.rock_storm: Rock Storm - a storm of rock whirls over the spot you aim at for 4 seconds: foes in a 6 block radius are battered every half second, pushed and slowed. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_earth.rising_ground: Rising Ground - the earth under the spot you aim at heaves up and throws every foe within 3.5 blocks into the air. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_earth.ground_wall: Ground Wall - a wall of earth stands between you and the blow: for 5 seconds you have Resistance II and one absorption heart.
nusmp.page.book_earth.mud_wall_cliff: Mud Wall Cliff - a cliff of packed mud rises in front of you (4 wide, 3 high) and slumps away after 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_earth.dirt_clod_seal: Dirt Clod Seal - clods of earth cling to one target within 14 blocks and set, sealing it in place and weakening it. The shared control lock applies.
nusmp.page.book_earth.giant_king_of_wisd: Giant King of Wisdom - a giant of earth rises round you for 4 seconds and stamps every foe within 6 blocks twice a second, pushing them away. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_earth.march_of_holy_fool: March of Holy Fools - a procession of earthen figures marches 18 blocks forward, trampling everything in a 2.5 block lane, pushing it back and slowing it. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.gilded_darts: Gilded Darts - three darts of gilded black alloy fly in a fan. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.patina_step: Patina Step - you slip up to 8 blocks forward behind a dark sheen of patina without hurting anyone.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.inlay_snare: Inlay Snare - gold wire inlays itself round one target within 16 blocks and pulls tight, holding and weakening it. The shared control lock applies.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.black_gold_wave: Black Gold Wave - a wave of molten black gold rolls 8 blocks in front of you and shoves foes back. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_shakudo.gilded_kiln: Gilded Kiln - the grimoire becomes a kiln: for 4 seconds a ring of glowing alloy round you scorches every foe within 5 blocks twice a second. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.refraction_veil: Refraction Veil - light bends round you: mobs within 16 blocks lose your trail and you turn invisible for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.geode_trap: Geode Trap - a geode is buried where you aim; after 1.2 seconds it cracks and sprays crystal over every foe within 3.5 blocks, hurting and slowing them. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_crystal.crystal_tide: Crystal Tide - a wave of growing crystal surges 16 blocks forward in a 3 block lane, pushing foes back and slowing them for 3 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_glass.lens_flare: Lens Flare - the grimoire focuses a sudden glare: foes within 4 blocks are hurt a little and blinded for 3 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_glass.glass_wall: Glass Wall - a wall of clear glass appears in front of you (4 wide, 3 high) and shatters away after 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_glass.stained_glass_fiel: Stained Glass Field - coloured panes rise round the spot you aim at for 4 seconds; foes in a 5 block radius are cut every half second, slowed and dazzled. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_filings: Iron Filings - a gust of iron filings blasts 5 blocks in front of you, scouring, blinding and slowing what it hits. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_iron.magnetic_pull: Magnetic Pull - the grimoire turns into a lodestone at the spot you aim at (up to 16 blocks) and drags every foe within 4 blocks toward it, hurting them.
nusmp.page.book_iron.iron_curtain: Iron Curtain - a curtain of iron drops round you for 8 seconds: Resistance II and three absorption hearts.
nusmp.page.book_copper.spark_coil: Spark Coil - a coil of copper throws a ball of sparks that bursts over 2 blocks and jolts foes (brief Slowness). Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_copper.voltaic_pulse: Voltaic Pulse - a pulse runs through the copper round you: foes within 5 blocks are shocked, shoved back and slowed. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_copper.lightning_rod: Lightning Rod - a copper rod is driven in where you aim; one second later the charge discharges and hits every foe within 4.5 blocks, slowing them. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.ruby_flare: Ruby Flare - a ruby flares red round you: foes within 3.5 blocks are hurt and set alight for 2 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
nusmp.page.book_corundum.sapphire_salve: Sapphire Salve - a calm blue light spreads from the grimoire: you and your allies within 8 blocks recover 15 percent of their health (healing decay applies).
nusmp.page.book_bronze.bronze_gong: Bronze Gong - the grimoire rings like a great gong: the shockwave hurts foes within 5 blocks, shoves them away and weakens them for 4 seconds. Damage scales with EP.
